rows.label: qst640405_msg0002
rows.name:
I don't know who you are, but please
drive off Glaring Angu, mo!

rows.label: qst640405_msg0102
rows.name:
Mo? Ololo and the others were worried
about Gisisi, mo!?

rows.label: qst640405_msg0103
rows.name:
She never listens to a thing I say,
but deep down she cares about her
father, mo...

rows.label: qst640405_msg0105
rows.name:
I'll finish the plant repairs quickly
and head home, mo.

rows.label: qst640405_msg0106
rows.name:
Then we'll eat the Starry-Sky Jewel
Tart I bought as a souvenir together,
mo.

rows.label: qst640405_msg0107
rows.name:
Family is warm like a hot spring,
mo...
